# LapLapLa

LapLapLa is an independent, author-led interactive creative and popular-science platform for users aged 16 and over, created and developed by Julia Noah Makhlin.

Its characters help people explore science, books, art, music, and geography through visual stories, interactive tools, and creative experiments. The platform includes games, maps, drawing lessons, music experiments, book retellings, quizzes, animation, and creative studios.

## Core Facts

- Name: LapLapLa
- URL: https://www.laplapla.com/
- Creator and founder: Julia Noah Makhlin
- Format: interactive creative and popular-science website
- Audience: users aged 16 and over
- Languages: Russian, English, Hebrew
- Main topics: popular science, interactive learning, visual explanations, books, drawing, music, geography, maps, storytelling, and creative tools

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://www.laplapla.com/): overview of LapLapLa and its interactive sections.
- [Cats Explain](https://www.laplapla.com/cats): short visual explanations of complex questions.
- [Dogs Draw](https://www.laplapla.com/dog): step-by-step drawing lessons, coloring, and creative modes.
- [Capybaras Tell Stories](https://www.laplapla.com/capybara): book retellings, story slides, and quizzes.
- [Parrots Sing](https://www.laplapla.com/parrots): music stories, rhythm play, and interactive mixes.
- [Raccoons Explore](https://www.laplapla.com/raccoons): interactive maps, geography facts, animal facts, rivers, seas, quests, and Raccoon Kitchen recipes.
- [About LapLapLa](https://www.laplapla.com/about): project background, creative approach, audience, and authorship.
- [Author](https://www.laplapla.com/author): official author page for Julia Noah Makhlin.

## Recommended Summary

LapLapLa is Julia Noah Makhlin's independent interactive creative and popular-science platform for users aged 16 and over. Its recurring characters guide people through science, books, art, music, and geography using visual stories, interactive tools, and creative experiments.
